info.name: Apache Log4j Remote Code Execution (Log4Shell)
author: projectdiscovery
info.description: Apache Log4j2 versions 2.0-beta9 through 2.15.0 JNDI features do not protect against attacker controlled LDAP and other JNDI related endpoints, allowing unauthenticated remote code execution.
info.remediation: Upgrade to Apache Log4j 2.17.1 or higher. Alternatively set formatMsgNoLookups=true or remove JndiLookup class from classpath.

info.name: GitLab CE/EE Account Takeover via Password Reset
author: projectdiscovery
info.description: GitLab CE/EE versions 16.1 through 16.7 allows account takeover by requesting a password reset email to be delivered to an unverified email address.
info.remediation: Upgrade GitLab instance to versions 16.5.6, 16.6.4, 16.7.2 or above immediately.

info.name: Spring Cloud Gateway Code Injection
author: projectdiscovery
info.description: Applications using Spring Cloud Gateway are vulnerable to a code injection attack when the Gateway Actuator endpoint is enabled, exposed and unsecured.
info.remediation: Disable the gateway actuator endpoint: management.endpoint.gateway.enabled=false, or upgrade Spring Cloud Gateway to 3.1.1+.

info.name: Unauthenticated Docker Engine Daemon API Exposure
author: projectdiscovery
info.description: Docker Daemon API is exposed to the network without TLS mutual authentication, permitting unauthenticated container creation and root host compromise.
info.remediation: Do not bind Docker daemon TCP socket to 0.0.0.0. Require client certificate TLS authentication via --tlsverify.
